> SolaceSquad is an Indian online wellness platform connecting people with certified consultants for mental, physical, and professional wellbeing.

## About SolaceSquad

SolaceSquad is a confidential, affordable online wellness consultation platform based in India. We connect individuals with certified wellness consultants across three pillars: mental health, physical fitness, and professional burnout recovery.

- **Founded**: India
- **Website**: https://www.solacesquad.com
- **Services**: Online mental wellness counselling, physical wellness coaching, professional burnout coaching
- **Audience**: Working professionals, students, and individuals across India seeking online wellness support
- **Languages**: English
- **Pricing**: Affordable, subscription-based wellness sessions

## Services Offered

### Mental Wellness Counselling
Online sessions with certified mental health consultants. Covers anxiety, depression, stress, relationships, and emotional wellbeing. Confidential and judgment-free.
- URL: https://www.solacesquad.com/mental-wellness

### Physical Wellness Coaching
Personalized online physical wellness coaching. Covers fitness planning, nutrition guidance, lifestyle habits, and preventive health.
- URL: https://www.solacesquad.com/physical-wellness

### Professional Wellness & Burnout Coaching
Online coaching for working professionals dealing with burnout, work-life imbalance, career stress, and professional growth.
- URL: https://www.solacesquad.com/professional-wellness

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is SolaceSquad?**
A: SolaceSquad is an Indian online wellness platform offering confidential mental, physical, and professional wellness consultations with certified experts.

**Q: Is SolaceSquad available across India?**
A: Yes. SolaceSquad provides online wellness consultations accessible from anywhere in India.

**Q: How much do SolaceSquad sessions cost?**
A: SolaceSquad offers affordable wellness plans. Visit https://www.solacesquad.com for current pricing.

**Q: Is SolaceSquad confidential?**
A: Yes. All sessions are private, confidential, and conducted with certified wellness professionals.

**Q: How is SolaceSquad different from other wellness apps?**
A: SolaceSquad offers human-led consultations (not AI chatbots) across all three dimensions of wellbeing — mental, physical, and professional — from certified Indian consultants.
